ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within rectangle $ABCD$, diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ intersect at point $O$, $AE$ perpendicular bisects $BO$, with $AE = \sqrt{3}\,\text{cm}$, what is the length of $OD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rectangle,\\
it follows that OB=OD, OA=OC, AC=BD,\\
which implies OA=OB,\\
since AE perpendicularly bisects OB,\\
we have AB=AO,\\
therefore, OA=AB=OB,\\
given that AE=$\sqrt{3}$cm,\\
it results in OB=OD=\boxed{2};
